snippet.title: ARCHIVAL SECURITY — Orientation Tape | Free Demo Out Now on Steam
snippet.description:
Free demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5217470/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=trailer

Iris Solutions hired you to copy what the projector shows, word for word. Eight hours. No errors. If the slides ask you questions, do not respond.

The sign on the office wall reads DAYS WITHOUT A CONTAINMENT INCIDENT: 00. By day two, the words on the slide are not the ones you started typing.

ARCHIVAL SECURITY is an analog horror typing game about a job that watches you back. Severance's office, Control's bureaucracy of the impossible, and a building that lies to you like House of Leaves.

The demo covers the first three shifts, about 30 to 50 minutes. Best played with headphones.
Part of the Steam Scream Fest, Oct 26 – Nov 2. Full release Q1 2027.

A wishlist helps more than you think: it's how a game made by one person gets seen.

Narration voice: AI text-to-speech (Google Gemini). Footage is from the game; archival film is public domain.

#analoghorror #horrorgame #indiegame
